Official SGPC LIVE | Gurbani Kirtan | Sachkhand Sri Harmandir Sahib, Sri Amritsar | Morning | Sawan 14 Samvat 558 Nanakshahi, Wednesday, July 29, 2026 

This is the official YouTube channel of the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC), Sri Amritsar. This channel is dedicated to the live broadcast of Gurbani Kirtan from Sachkhand Sri Harmandir Sahib Sri Darbar Sahib, Sri Amritsar, the central Sikh shrine, videos related to Sikh history, documentaries, Gurmat Samagams (Religious Congregations) organised by SGPC at Gurdwaras under its management on different historic occasions. 
The SGPC is the foremost organisation of Sikhs established on November 15, 1920, and is governed under the provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, of 1925, in India. The SGPC is responsible for the management of historical Gurdwara Sahibs (Sikh shrines) in India and it also deals with concerns of the Sikh community in India and across the globe.

All rights of Gurbani Kirtan, Katha, Hukamnama, broadcast from Sachkhand Sri Harmandar Sahib Sri Darbar Sahib, Sri Amritsar are reserved with the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC), Sri Amritsar. Any channel, web, YouTube channel, website, social-media platform, other than the channel authorized by the SGPC, has no right to re-direct, re-stream, download or upload Gurbani broadcast from this YouTube channel (SGPC, Sri Amritsar).

videoDetails.shortDescription:
ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨ, ਸੱਚਖੰਡ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ | ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ | ੧੪ ਸਾਵਣ ਸੰਮਤ ੫੫੮ ਨਾਨਕਸ਼ਾਹੀ, ਬੁੱਧਵਾਰ | ੨੯ ਜੁਲਾਈ, ੨੦੨੬ 

Official SGPC LIVE | Gurbani Kirtan | Sachkhand Sri Harmandir Sahib, Sri Amritsar | Morning | Sawan 14 Samvat 558 Nanakshahi, Wednesday, July 29, 2026 

This is the official YouTube channel of the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC), Sri Amritsar. This channel is dedicated to the live broadcast of Gurbani Kirtan from Sachkhand Sri Harmandir Sahib Sri Darbar Sahib, Sri Amritsar, the central Sikh shrine, videos related to Sikh history, documentaries, Gurmat Samagams (Religious Congregations) organised by SGPC at Gurdwaras under its management on different historic occasions. 
The SGPC is the foremost organisation of Sikhs established on November 15, 1920, and is governed under the provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, of 1925, in India. The SGPC is responsible for the management of historical Gurdwara Sahibs (Sikh shrines) in India and it also deals with concerns of the Sikh community in India and across the globe.

All rights of Gurbani Kirtan, Katha, Hukamnama, broadcast from Sachkhand Sri Harmandar Sahib Sri Darbar Sahib, Sri Amritsar are reserved with the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC), Sri Amritsar. Any channel, web, YouTube channel, website, social-media platform, other than the channel authorized by the SGPC, has no right to re-direct, re-stream, download or upload Gurbani broadcast from this YouTube channel (SGPC, Sri Amritsar).

Official links of different platforms of SGPC, Sri Amritsar.

Facebook for Gurbani Kirtan broadcast from Sri Darbar Sahib:  https://www.facebook.com/SGPCSriAmritsar

Website: https://sgpc.net

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/sgpcamritsar.org

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sgpc_amritsar
